# Per-project harness formats: Claude Code reads a directory of SKILL.md
# files, Codex and the other AGENTS.md readers read one file. Install writes
# whichever the project already uses, and never touches the rest of AGENTS.md.

fulcrum sync

# A project using neither convention gets the Claude layout by default.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/fresh
exists fresh/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
! exists fresh/AGENTS.md
grep '"targets"' fresh/.fulcrum/.fulcrum-installed.json

# A project with an AGENTS.md gets its skills there instead — detected, not
# configured — with the surrounding file left alone.
mkdir codexproj
cp house-rules.md codexproj/AGENTS.md
fulcrum skills install $WORK/codexproj
! exists codexproj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep '# House rules' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Keep this paragraph.' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep 'BEGIN fulcrum skills' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep '### corpus-writing-specs' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Name the behavior, not the implementation.' codexproj/AGENTS.md

# Re-running replaces the block rather than stacking copies, and the
# project's own text still survives.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/codexproj
grep -count=1 'BEGIN fulcrum skills' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep -count=1 '### corpus-writing-specs' codexproj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Keep this paragraph.' codexproj/AGENTS.md

# A project that uses both gets both.
mkdir bothproj
cp house-rules.md bothproj/AGENTS.md
mkdir bothproj/.claude
fulcrum skills install $WORK/bothproj
exists bothproj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep 'BEGIN fulcrum skills' bothproj/AGENTS.md

# An explicit target overrides detection; a bogus one is refused.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/fresh --target agents
exists fresh/AGENTS.md
fulcrum -code 2 skills install $WORK/fresh --target sublime
grep 'unknown --target' last-stderr.txt

-- house-rules.md --
# House rules

Keep this paragraph.
